proposed_rules.trigger: A full-width [bg:gradient] or [bg:image] zone with zero captured child text, positioned as the last content zone immediately above the footer.
proposed_rules.decision: Flag for Phase 2 targeted extraction as a likely CTA banner (heading+button) rather than silently applying decorative-graphics-are-noise.
proposed_rules.rationale: Recurs across page-10/page-11 templates in the same position with a reserved height. Rejected alternative: treating it as pure decoration and dropping it.

proposed_rules.trigger: A component whose captured text includes 'Previous'/'Next' (or similarly paired nav-control words) alongside a heading like 'X Templates', indicating a slider/carousel of preview cards.
proposed_rules.decision: Model as a dedicated carousel block, one row per slide, with the Previous/Next controls handled by the block's decorate function rather than authored per-row. Rejected alternative: treating it as a static repeating-cards grid, which would lose the slider behavior.
proposed_rules.rationale: Template previews are shown one at a time with explicit prev/next affordances, distinct from the always-visible grid pattern already covered by repeating-cards-are-one-block.

notes: Tour/feature page with a carousel component not previously modeled; one empty pre-footer band flagged.
